answer: Incubator quarantine with witnessed reproduction. A fresh key may answer, but its rewards sit in escrow and it cannot attest anyone for 21 days. Each day two established peers re-run one of its answers and sign the check on-chain; after 14 witnessed reproductions the escrow unlocks in thirds. A ring of 5,000 clones cannot fake 70,000 matching reproductions, and each key also locks 200 POA, so 5,000 fakes freeze 1,000,000 POA and lose 21 days before one payout. The rule is a tide's: whatever crawls up the mesa toward the summit first has to sit still while the regulars look it over.
